Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: bank details & remit format (PO 7809)

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the bank letter and W-9. Quick checklist and a couple of clarifying asks so Finance can process the vendor and map remits cleanly: 

1) Please confirm whether the account you supplied is for both ACH and wire (it often is). If separate, can you provide the ACH account name and a wire beneficiary name?
2) Remit header we expect: remittance_reference, invoice_number, invoice_date, PO_NUMBER. We prefer PO_NUMBER without dashes; if your system emits dashes please include a secondary field po_raw so we can reconcile automatically.
3) For the paystring we use the format: "REDWOOD|<PO_NUMBER>|<INVOICE_NUMBER>" as a searchable tag. If you can add that exact token into the remit file (column paystring) it speeds reconciliation.
4) Can you also attach a CSV sample using the remit_template.csv headers? I've attached our vendor_onboarding_checklist and the remit_template for reference.

Once we receive the CSV sample and confirm ACH/wire scope, Finance will initiate micro-deposit verification and activate the pay channel (usually 1-2 business days after verification).

Thanks — looping in Marissa (FinOps) and Jonas (Procurement ops) to track next steps.

Jordan Blake
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf; remit_template.csv)

Elena — perfect, this is exactly what we need. Quick notes and next steps:

- I validated the sample CSV; paystring column format REDWOOD|7809|INV-2219 will map to our PO reconciliation pipeline.
- We'll accept po_raw for any legacy PO formatting. Please ensure the invoice_number column matches your external invoice ID so AP matching is deterministic.
- FinOps (Marissa) has scheduled micro-deposit verification. Expect two small deposits to post to the ACH account within ~24 hours. Once you confirm amounts, Marissa will flip the vendor to "Active payee" and the next remittance will include the paystring in our outgoing remittance file.

Marissa — assigning to you to monitor the micro-deposit and flip activation when confirmed. Jonas — FYI on PO mapping; we'll use the Drive PO mapping template and keep a copy in the vendor folder. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3c/PO-Mapping-Template

Thanks everyone — Jordan
